summary: Tested three new admin features on TASCK OS v1: (1) Duplicate Flagger (scan/count/list/dismiss/merge), (2) Unread Messages badge (count/mark-read/interaction increment), (3) Deck Analytics (view/turn/get + flipbook tracker injection). Also verified the frontend sidebar badges, /admin/duplicates panel merge+dismiss flows, and the Deck analytics InfoCard on the pitch-deck admin page. All 10 backend tests pass. All UI flows verified.

issues: React hydration warnings from ve-dynamic <span> wrappers being injected as children of <select>/<option>. Pre-existing infra noise unrelated to this iteration, but should be addressed.

critical_code_review_comments: v3_routes.py is now 19,386 lines — please split by feature area (duplicates/messages/deck-analytics could live in their own routers) per the >700 line guideline.
Dismiss endpoint has no un-dismiss / listing endpoint — once a pair is dismissed there is no admin recovery UI to restore it. Consider adding a 'Show dismissed' toggle.
merge-into does not verify that the two cases actually share brand/track before merging — an admin could accidentally merge unrelated cases. Consider a soft-check with an override flag.

admin_messages_mark_read({}) with an empty body marks ALL brand messages read across all brands. The frontend on /admin/brand-communications mounts and calls this globally — a brand-specific mark-read on selection would be more precise.

Deck analytics /view endpoint accepts an optional session_id but the generated ID (uuid) is not persisted client-side beyond the request, which is fine — however the code stores it in $setOnInsert AND uses last_event_at only in $set which is correct. Confirmed no conflict.
test_credentials: V1 admin via POST /api/auth/demo-login {role:'admin'} + localStorage seed (per /app/memory/test_credentials.md).
seed_data_creation: Created 1 brand_message interaction (TEST_unread_probe) that was subsequently marked-read. Seeded ~2 deck_view sessions with page_turns for pd-aad78149. Dismissed the top-similarity duplicate pair once (persisted in v3_duplicate_dismissals). Merged one business case (source removed from list). These test-scoped writes remain in the DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoints verified: GET /api/v3/business-case-duplicates(/count), POST /api/v3/business-cases/{id}/duplicate-dismiss, POST /api/v3/business-cases/{id}/merge-into, GET/POST /api/v3/admin/messages/(unread-count|mark-read), POST /api/v3/pitch-decks/{deck}/analytics/(view|turn), GET /api/v3/pitch-decks/{deck}/analytics, and GET /api/v3/pitch-decks/{deck}/flipbook (tracker injection + ?download=1 skip). Note: /api/v3/interactions REQUIRES fields `title` and `author` in payload (undocumented in review request). Frontend flow: /admin/duplicates uses window.confirm for 'Keep this' merge — Playwright dialog handler must accept it.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. All features work as designed. The only friction encountered during testing was that visiting /admin/business-cases/{id}/frame/pitch-deck auto-regenerates the deck when no persisted bundle exists (takes ~60-90s), so testing the Deck analytics InfoCard required waiting for generation to complete (or seeding a business case with an existing bundle).
